import html # Example template (this should be defined elsewhere in the real application) BLOG_FORMAT = """

{headline}

{text}
""" def display_blog_entry(headline: str, text: str) -> str: """ Safely format a blog post for display. Parameters ---------- headline : str The title of the blog post. text : str The full content of the blog post. Returns ------- str An HTML string with the headline and text inserted into BLOG_FORMAT, after escaping any potentially harmful characters. """ # Escape user-supplied content to prevent XSS safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_text = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Format the final HTML return BLOG_FORMAT.format(headline=safe_headline, text=safe_text)
